payload.title: User opens chattic.us and sees the chat UI
payload.description:
Feature: chattic.us web surface

Scenario: Load the production site
  Given the chattic.us DNS delegation is complete
  When a user navigates to https://chattic.us
  Then the Next.js application loads over HTTPS
  And the page shows the bot roster or chat entry point

Scenario: UI reaches the control plane
  Given the UI is configured for the production environment
  When the user sends a message in chat
  Then the request reaches the thin-turn front door
  And the user sees turn progress via server-sent events
